description.value: This study examined whether dosage of the 5-HTTLPR-s allele was associated with gray matter volume differently in healthy older controls and patients with behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia using whole-brain voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: We performed voxel-based morphometry of 179 cognitively normal older adults and 24 bvFTD cases to determine brain changes associated with dose (0/1/2) of 5-HTTLPR-s allele.
